Title: [JOURNEY] OrderRequest — three sessions returned, then two purchase orders that regroup their lines: each line is ordered once, the buyer cart stays empty, and every order holds exactly its lines
Preconditions: Dedicated punchout buyer (the PUNCHOUT_MAPPING_REQUISITION buyer, a user mapping); Punchout.Enabled on for the configuration-0 store; configuration 0. Fresh sessions for this case only: a requisition item is ordered by one purchase order at a time and the PO number and payload ids are terminal. Oracle: VCST-6764 / PR #12 plan (PNCO-… cases of the purchase order lifecycle). Fixture: PUNCHOUT_COMBO_MULTISESSION — S1 = plain ×2 + box-unit ×1 + product C ×3, S2 = product D ×1 + product E ×2, S3 = product F ×1, product G spare; every unit price and session total is distinct (plain ×2 and box-unit ×1 share a line total: told apart by sku, quantity and unit price). Title: OrderRequest — a cart edit made AFTER the return is ignored: the order holds the returned quantities and prices, and the edited cart is left as it is
Preconditions: Dedicated punchout buyer (the PUNCHOUT_MAPPING_REQUISITION buyer, a user mapping); Punchout.Enabled on for the configuration-0 store; configuration 0. Fresh sessions for this case only: a requisition item is ordered by one purchase order at a time and the PO number and payload ids are terminal. Oracle: VCST-6764 / PR #12 plan (PNCO-… cases of the purchase order lifecycle). Fresh session returns plain ×2 + box-unit ×1. After the return the buyer adds plain ×5 to the cart again (a new cart line) and the ERP then orders the RETURNED lines at the returned quantity and price. The order is built from the requisition snapshot, never from the live cart: prices are not recalculated and cart changes after the return are ignored (runtime change of PR #12).
